primitives.name: Scouting Report Embedding
primitives.verbatim_quote: This work presents a first-of-its-kind dataset of almost 10,000 scouting reports for minor league, international, and draft prospects.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D': 'dataset of scouting reports, dimensionless', 'N': 'number of reports, integer'}
primitives.assumptions: Reports are representative samples of amateur player traits; textual descriptions encode actionable features.

primitives.name: Player Potential Classifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: With this dataset, we employ several deep neural networks to predict if minor league players will make the MLB given their scouting report.

primitives.assumptions: Classifier learns non-linear mappings from input features to binary outcome; temporal consistency assumed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_{mlb} < 0.1 or > 0.9, classifier confidence intervals widen due to class imbalance.

layer2.mapping: Deep network output is isomorphic to posterior probability distribution over MLB eligibility.
layer2.telemetry: Cross-validation AUC score on holdout set of prospects.

The core insight is that scouting reports encode both structured (numerical grades) and unstructured (textual narratives) information about player potential. These are unified into a latent space via deep embedding techniques, enabling probabilistic prediction of MLB success. The dual nature of the data—quantitative and qualitative—requires a mathematical framework that can handle both modalities simultaneously. The failure mode occurs when either modality is under-represented or misaligned, leading to poor generalization. The isomorphism between narrative structure and performance outcomes suggests a deep learning architecture capable of capturing semantic nuances in player descriptions. This aligns with prior work in statistical projections like KATOH, which failed to incorporate qualitative traits, thus limiting its accuracy. The proposed primitives form a coherent basis for GSI's Bayesian inference engine and GSE's dynamic player trajectory modeling.
